description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Revocation of the Order made to appoint Mr. Palitha Weerasekara and appointed Mr. T. E. Santharajan as the arbitrator for settlement of the Industrial Dispute between Mr. A. P. K. Weeraratne and National Water Supply & Drainage Board and appointed Mr. K. M. Sarathchandra and Mr. Suneth Lokubogahawatta as the Arbitrators for the Industrial Disputes between Free Trade Zones & General Services Employees' Union and Creasy Foods Limited and between Mr. R. J. M. P. G. Y. B. Jayasekara and National Water Supply & Drainage Board respectively and Revocation of Order made to appoint Mr. W. G. Deen and appointed Mr. S. Virithamulla as the Arbitrator for the Industrial Dispute between Mr. A. W. Samarasuriya and Sri Lanka Transport Board (S & E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders and revocations of orders under Section 4(1) for industrial dispute arbitration appointments. It involves statutory instruments and legal procedures for dispute resolution between employees/employers, falling squarely within legal/regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
